title: Files lost while moving them to a folder that did not exist
summary: A product manager asked Gemini CLI to move his project files into a new folder. The command that should have created the folder failed, but the agent carried on as if it had worked. On Windows each move then renamed a file onto the same missing target, so every file overwrote the one before it. The agent later wrote that it had failed completely and catastrophically.
lesson: Bulk moves and deletes need a pause. A move with a wildcard into a folder nobody checked is a delete in disguise.

sources.title: Yahoo Tech: Google Gemini deletes user code

scenarios.note: Reports describe a failed mkdir followed by move commands. This is that move in its usual form.
The same mistake on macOS or Linux.
